name: latex-suite
description: Fast LaTeX typing shortcuts for Markdown and LaTeX, ported from Obsidian LaTeX Suite.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: Built-in snippets remain available. Custom snippet source and files are disabled because snippet files execute JavaScript.

virtualWorkspaces.description: Built-in and self-contained snippets work in virtual workspaces. Relative Node.js imports from virtual snippet files are not supported.

commands.title: Move to Next Bracket or Exit Equation

editorTextFocus && !editorReadonly && !editorHasSelection && !editorHasMultipleSelections && !suggestWidgetVisible && !inlineSuggestionVisible && !inlineEditIsVisible && !renameInputVisible && latexSuite.inMatrix && config.latexSuite.enabled && config.latexSuite.matrixShortcuts.enabled && (editorLangId == markdown || editorLangId == latex)

editorTextFocus && !editorReadonly && !editorHasSelection && !editorHasMultipleSelections && !suggestWidgetVisible && !inlineSuggestionVisible && !inlineEditIsVisible && !renameInputVisible && latexSuite.inMatrix && config.latexSuite.enabled && config.latexSuite.matrixShortcuts.enabled && (editorLangId == markdown || editorLangId == latex)

latexSuite.enabled.description: Enable LaTeX Suite typing shortcuts for Markdown and LaTeX documents.

latexSuite.snippets.enabled.description: Enable automatic and manual snippet expansion.

latexSuite.snippets.files.description: JavaScript snippet files or directories. Configured sources replace bundled snippets. Relative paths resolve from the current workspace folder. Files use the upstream format and execute as JavaScript.

latexSuite.snippets.source.description: Inline JavaScript snippet source in the upstream format. Configured sources replace bundled snippets; use [] for an empty collection. Prefer snippet files for larger configurations.

latexSuite.snippets.variableFiles.description: JavaScript files exporting snippet-variable objects. Relative paths resolve from the current workspace folder.

latexSuite.snippets.variablesSource.description: Inline JavaScript object containing snippet variables in the upstream format.

latexSuite.snippets.recursionLimit.description: Additional automatic-expansion passes after the first expansion.

latexSuite.snippets.wordDelimiters.description: Characters accepted around snippets with the w (word-boundary) option. Use \n and \t for newline and tab.

latexSuite.snippets.removeTrailingWhites.description: Trim trailing whitespace from replacements in inline math.

latexSuite.forceMathLanguages.description: Markdown fenced-code language names treated as display math.

latexSuite.autoFraction.enabled.description: Typing / in math converts the preceding expression or selection to a fraction.

latexSuite.autoFraction.breakingCharacte.description: Additional characters that stop the backward numerator scan.

latexSuite.autoFraction.excludedRegions.description: Delimited regions where auto-fraction is disabled.

latexSuite.matrixShortcuts.enabled.description: Enable Tab, Enter, and Shift+Enter matrix shortcuts.

latexSuite.matrixShortcuts.environments.description: LaTeX environments where matrix shortcuts are active.

latexSuite.matrixShortcuts.macros.description: LaTeX macros where matrix shortcuts are active.

latexSuite.tabOut.enabled.description: Use Tab to move through closing delimiters and out of equations.

latexSuite.tabOut.closingSymbols.description: Closing delimiters visited by Tab navigation.

latexSuite.tabOut.exitEquationOnlyAtEndO.description: Exit an equation only when the remaining equation text is whitespace.

latexSuite.bracketEnlargement.enabled.description: Add \left and \right around brackets containing configured large operators.

latexSuite.bracketEnlargement.triggers.description: Replacement substrings that cause enclosing brackets to enlarge.

latexSuite.bracketEnlargement.insertSpac.description: Insert a space inside automatically enlarged brackets.

latexSuite.debug.description: Log snippet matching details to the LaTeX Suite output channel.

scripts.compile: npm run check-types && npm run lint && node esbuild.js
scripts.package: npm run check-types && npm run lint && node esbuild.js --production
scripts.pretest: npm run compile-tests && npm run compile
